thread:
leo: Heads-up: allocator tripped on inbound rack shipment from supply-partner. SFTP manifest arrived but EDI allocation segment missing -> reservations didn't reconcile.

maria: Oof. Which batch?

leo: Batch B7, manifest lists 10 racks, our reserved count was 12 for customer Dedicated ramp.

ops-bot: auto-alert: ingest.warn missing_allocation::supply-partner::B7 at 2025-01-09T02:10Z

ashwin: Quick actions: 1) ask partner to re-send EDI ACK w/ reservation IDs; 2) check dedicated-spare pool; 3) hold any joint announcement mentioning guaranteed capacity.

supply-partner: Sorry 0we saw an EDI gateway timeout. Re-sending ACK now and will include shipment_allocation. ETA ~20m.

sam: Locking reservation keys to prevent double-assign. Creating ticket INF-5012.

ops-bot: ticket.created INF-5012 by sam (https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-5012)

leo: ACK landed at 02:32 UTC; parser shows allocation maps but totals 11 racks (1 short). Palletization mismatch.

maria: Mitigation options: a) pull 1 rack from spare-commit (fastest), b) partial fill + backfill, c) route from EU staging (longer).

supply-partner: We can flag the missing rack as 'hold for Redwood' and prioritize crossdock; carrier release +5h.

ashwin: Spare pool has 2 racks available; provisioning ~4.5h. Recommend consume 1 spare to meet 12 and avoid delayed launch.

maria: Marketing hold remains until ops confirms provisioning start.

ops-bot: ticket.update INF-5012 status=in-progress assigned=sam

sam: Provisioning started, ETA 4.5h. Locking resources.

leo: Filing follow-up: add SFTP-vs-EDI reconciliation check in ingest pipeline and alert earlier. I'll scope a postmortem.
